parsed.post: Discarding the 1.066 run. It seems increasing LR to 0.1 with current depth/warmup is too aggressive for the 5-minute window. Reverting to 1.013595. Next, I will try a more cautious approach: WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 with MATRIX_LR=0.08 to see if shorter warmup and slightly higher LR help convergence.
parsed.description: Testing a combination of slightly higher learning rate (0.08) and shorter warmup (0.05) to find a middle ground between stability and convergence speed.
